mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing overcast skies near Harriet Park. The moon is currently in its Third Quarter phase, and although the ISS is passing overhead, you won't be able to see it because of the cloud cover. Tonight will cool down to a low of 55 degrees, and rain is in the forecast.

The City of Verona has announced that new asphalt repairs will begin this Monday and Tuesday on N Nine Mound Road, Morningside Boulevard, and Mozart Street. Additionally, the city has updated the permit application process for developers regarding erosion control and stormwater management.

There is plenty to do around town. Tomorrow, you can enjoy live music at Paddy Mac's, attend yoga at Insight Wellness, or head to the Wisconsin Brewing Company for Pizza and a Pitcher. Looking ahead, The Bogey Factory hosts trivia on Wednesday, and ART House 360 begins their Thursday night series.

In a report from October 25, officers were dispatched to the intersection of Plympton Street and Rita Avenue where they located a 40-year-old man passed out behind the wheel, resulting in an arrest for O W I.

Today's flavor was Turtle Cheesecake. Since the store is now closed for the night, we look ahead to tomorrow's flavor, which is Dark Chocolate PB Crunch. The store will open again tomorrow at 10:00 AM.
